title: Funds from bids can get locked if amAMM is disabled for a pool
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  The amAMM can be disabled for a pool via the pool and global overrides.  All the interactions with the amAMM contract require that it is enabled for the pool involved in the operation.  If the amAMM is disabled for a pool after it has been active, this can lock the funds of the bidders as:  - Pending refunds cannot be claimed. - `nextBid` cannot be canceled and thus, the deposit gets locked. - `topBid` remaining deposits cannot be recovered.  ## Recommendations  Consider removing the requirement for amAMM to be enabled in `cla
